title: Invoice is generated when order is completed
gherkin:
Given an order exists with status 'completed'
When the invoice generation rule is triggered
Then an invoice should be generated for that order
rationale: Core functionality - invoices should be automatically generated upon order completion
generationSummary: Test cases for invoice generation rule functionality, covering invoice creation, validation, and processing scenarios based on the requirement specification.

title: Invoice contains correct order details
gherkin:
Given an order with items, quantities, and prices
When an invoice is generated
Then the invoice should contain all order items with correct quantities and prices
rationale: Invoices must accurately reflect the order information for billing purposes
generationSummary: Test cases for invoice generation rule functionality, covering invoice creation, validation, and processing scenarios based on the requirement specification.

title: Invoice is not generated for cancelled orders
gherkin:
Given an order with status 'cancelled'
When the invoice generation rule is evaluated
Then no invoice should be generated
rationale: Invoices should not be created for orders that have been cancelled
generationSummary: Test cases for invoice generation rule functionality, covering invoice creation, validation, and processing scenarios based on the requirement specification.

title: Invoice includes customer information
gherkin:
Given a completed order from a customer
When an invoice is generated
Then the invoice should include the customer's name, address, and contact information
rationale: Invoices must contain customer details for identification and delivery purposes
generationSummary: Test cases for invoice generation rule functionality, covering invoice creation, validation, and processing scenarios based on the requirement specification.

title: Invoice calculates total amount correctly
gherkin:
Given an order with multiple items at different prices
When an invoice is generated
Then the invoice total should equal the sum of all item prices multiplied by their quantities
rationale: Invoice totals must be mathematically accurate for proper billing
generationSummary: Test cases for invoice generation rule functionality, covering invoice creation, validation, and processing scenarios based on the requirement specification.

title: Invoice is generated only once per order
gherkin:
Given a completed order
When the invoice generation rule is triggered multiple times
Then only one invoice should exist for that order
rationale: Duplicate invoices should be prevented to avoid billing errors
generationSummary: Test cases for invoice generation rule functionality, covering invoice creation, validation, and processing scenarios based on the requirement specification.

title: Invoice includes tax calculations
gherkin:
Given an order with taxable items
When an invoice is generated
Then the invoice should include applicable tax amounts based on the order location
rationale: Invoices must include tax information for compliance and accurate billing
generationSummary: Test cases for invoice generation rule functionality, covering invoice creation, validation, and processing scenarios based on the requirement specification.

title: Invoice is generated with unique invoice number
gherkin:
Given a completed order
When an invoice is generated
Then the invoice should have a unique invoice number
rationale: Each invoice must have a unique identifier for tracking and reference purposes

Given an order that triggers invoice generation
When the invoice is created
